HTA is a tool that can be utilized in the decision-making process.
the barriers in the utilization of HTAs are mainly related to the lack of awareness and knowledge on HTA, and its importance in the policy level, professional level, and public level.
there is no single solution for the barriers of HTAs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the utilization of HTAs is not only dependent on the quality of reports but also on the culture of the country.
the utilization of HTAs is a complex process and requires a comprehensive approach to be successful.
HTA reports should be prepared based on the needs of decision makers and the reports should be presented in a format that is easy to understand for them.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the barriers toward utilization of HTA in Iran are different in three levels of policymakers, specialists, and the public.
HTA should be considered as an integral part of the health system and not just as a tool to evaluate the efficiency of technologies.
HTA reports should not only be prepared by the HTA centers, but also by other organizations such as the Ministry of Health and the Health Insurance Organization.
